messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: P0 - saffron-customer (enterprise/VPC) elevated 5xx and request latency in eu2. Paging SRE Oncall. Automated detection: 35% of requests failing in dedicated pool cypress-eu2-dedicated
SRE Oncall: Acknowledged. Investigating now. @Anna Li can you pull pool health and recent deploys?
Anna Li: Looking at metrics — CPU and GPU utilization normal, but backend app process is returning 502s from the model-proxy. No deploys in last 6h.
Jake Morales: Customer reports spike at 10:12 UTC, correlates with a regional upstream egress flapping event. Could be routing causing partial malformed requests.
Maya Patel: Customer (account team) confirming impact: prolonged 502s and failed calls for ~25% of users in EU. They've opened internal incident and are asking for ETA.
SRE Oncall: Plan: 1) Isolate tenant traffic to warm pool saffron-warm-eu2, 2) DNS weighted shift to 100% warm if healthy, 3) rollback/patch proxy if needed. Starting warm capacity spin-up now. @Sven Nordin can you prepare weighted DNS change?
Sven Nordin: Warm pool already has 6 warm nodes (from health runbook). I'll update weights in TrafficDirector, lower primary to 30%, warm to 70% then check errors.
PagerDuty: [pagerduty] Incident acknowledged by SRE Oncall (SRE Oncall)
SRE Oncall: Executing health check on saffron-warm-eu2 -- sharing command:
```
curl -is https://saffron-warm-eu2.redwood-hosted.net/healthz | head -n 20
```
Anna Li: Health checks green, model-proxy 200s on all warm nodes, KV cache primed. Starting gradual shift now.
Sven Nordin: Updated TrafficDirector weights: primary cypress-eu2-dedicated -> 30%, saffron-warm-eu2 -> 70%. TTL unchanged (60s). Monitoring error rate and latency.
Jake Morales: Observed error rate drop to 12% within 90s, tail latency improving. Customer connection count to dedicated pool falling.
Maya Patel: Notifying customer of mitigation, asking if they want immediate full cutover or can wait for steady state.
Priya Rao: Recommend full cutover to warm pool given risk of data corruption in VPC path. If warm stable for 5m, move to 100%.
SRE Oncall: Agreed. Moving to 100% in 3..2..1. Changing weights to 0/100.
Sven Nordin: Weights now primary 0%, saffron-warm-eu2 100%. Routing converged.
Incident Bot: Automated note: traffic shift complete, rollback window 15m.
Anna Li: Running quick smoke: sample requests succeed, no 502s observed over last 3m.
Jake Morales: Captured logs from cypress-eu2-dedicated: repeated upstream dial failures to internal egress gateway. Looks like transient BGP session resets. Filing infra ticket.
Maya Patel: Customer updated: traffic fully routed to warm pool, errors resolved for most users. They want postmortem and timeline.
SRE Oncall: Short-term mitigation complete. Actions: 1) Keep warm pool at 100% until infra confirms egress stability, 2) create incident ticket for network team to investigate BGP/eBGP flaps, 3) prepare cherry-pick patch if model-proxy requires restart.
Priya Rao: I'll coordinate postmortem and include customer-facing timeline. Assigning follow-ups to owners.
Sven Nordin: Rolling back TTL to 30s for faster future cutovers (if needed) and documenting weight changes.
SRE Oncall: Keeping channel open until handoff. If no regression in 20m, will mark mitigated and start customer postmortem notes.
PagerDuty: [pagerduty] Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring by SRE Oncall
Anna Li: No regressions in last 18m. Confirming stable.
Maya Patel: Customer acknowledges mitigation and appreciates fast response. Requesting a scheduled call for 1:1 postmortem tomorrow.
SRE Oncall: Thanks team. Filing incident ticket 3355551111 in JIRA (INC-4821) and will add timeline + logs. Closing slack thread after postmortem prep. :white_check_mark:
